*America 250 Events & Activities**July 1–31 | cityofirvine.gov/america250
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/http:%2F%2Fcityofirvine.gov%2Famerica250%3Futm_medium=email%26utm_source=govdelivery/2/0100019f1b4e739c-a75890d8-085e-4be8-99be-086cc986cba2-000000/1kMiQCbvGNLn_dDJx60wU_T6XjX3FBnZw6ENZ4TPUo4=452>*

Celebrate America's 250th birthday with the City of Irvine. Discover
hands-on activities all month long, including themed storytimes, historical
learning experiences, outdoor challenges, and interactive programs that
explore moments and ideas that helped shape our nation. *Learn More
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/http:%2F%2Fcityofirvine.gov%2Famerica250%3Futm_medium=email%26utm_source=govdelivery/3/0100019f1b4e739c-a75890d8-085e-4be8-99be-086cc986cba2-000000/NBA_rmJoiL0xe3N-WNsr5gONx_zHOjqu2rXcK2dearU=452>*

*Park & Recreation Month ChallengeJuly 1–31 | cityofirvine.gov/parks
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/http:%2F%2Fcityofirvine.gov%2Fparks%3Futm_medium=email%26utm_source=govdelivery/2/0100019f1b4e739c-a75890d8-085e-4be8-99be-086cc986cba2-000000/GD9A0QBIXlO6RNDOK8fkCS2lxZ1fxE8mzeA7-bn2kJs=452>*

Explore Irvine's award-winning parks, libraries, community centers, and
cultural destinations with the City of Irvine Park & Recreation Challenge,
presented by Hoag. Complete activities, collect stamps, and earn prizes as
you find new frontiers in your own backyard. *Learn More
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fcityofirvine.gov%2Fparks%3Futm_medium=email%26utm_source=govdelivery/1/0100019f1b4e739c-a75890d8-085e-4be8-99be-086cc986cba2-000000/89dbIEKV3LVQBgk7iQmzjKh8viKknXmaTCn6cLuMg-Y=452>*

<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fcityofirvine.gov%2Fcommunications-engagement%2Ffield-valor-america-250%3Futm_medium=email%26utm_source=govdelivery/1/0100019f1b4e739c-a75890d8-085e-4be8-99be-086cc986cba2-000000/gMoe5iYOdiTX_6-9UA1oSS20OvzvuRypHtUc-FXQjIY=452>


*Field of Valor**July 1–31 | Irvine Civic Center*

In honor of America 250, the annual Field of Valor display on the Irvine
Civic Center lawn will feature 250 flags commemorating veterans, active
duty, and fallen service members. *Learn More
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fcityofirvine.gov%2Fcommunications-engagement%2Ffield-valor-america-250%3Futm_medium=email%26utm_source=govdelivery/2/0100019f1b4e739c-a75890d8-085e-4be8-99be-086cc986cba2-000000/9z79XXOpGw-GXxMTxa6ibFrigCA4qYtlPP6QasNpnaM=452>*
[image: Super Swim Lesson]
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fcityofirvine.gov%2Faquatics-centers%2Fsuper-swim-lesson%3Futm_medium=email%26utm_source=govdelivery/1/0100019f1b4e739c-a75890d8-085e-4be8-99be-086cc986cba2-000000/mU5Riqzv9ftG5DqH-G9LCHAMP2ZH5Cy838nya-uzWuk=452>

*Super Swim Lesson*
*July 10, 5:30 p.m. | William Woollett Jr. Aquatics Center*

Make a splash at the Super Swim Lesson which promotes water safety and
drowning prevention. Participants of all ages and abilities are invited to
enjoy a group lesson, followed by recreational swimming and a
family-friendly movie night. *Learn More
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fcityofirvine.gov%2Faquatics-centers%2Fsuper-swim-lesson%3Futm_medium=email%26utm_source=govdelivery/2/0100019f1b4e739c-a75890d8-085e-4be8-99be-086cc986cba2-000000/bvvEQOwOh-vqK6gfar8ht43XN3V06z0rn4qoQOYRz_4=452>*

[image: Irvine Annual Opening Reception]
<https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fcityofirvine.gov%2Farts-irvine%2Firvine-annual%3Futm_medium=email%26utm_source=govdelivery/1/0100019f1b4e739c-a75890d8-085e-4be8-99be-086cc986cba2-000000/L1nUSZcNMWK7FwBcKm0innkeD8LxdIl0rFCqFIK1J1Y=452>

*Irvine Annual Opening Reception*

*July 11, 2–4 p.m. | Irvine Fine Arts Center*

Join us for the free opening reception of the 42nd Irvine Annual Saturday,
July 11, from 2 to 4 p.m. at the Irvine Fine Arts Center. Discover a juried
exhibition showcasing innovative contemporary artwork from local and
regional artists working across a wide range of visual media. *Learn More
